answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in beacon and timber lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the sable graph. A farm of 2870 identities would post 2493 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
